source: Installed Steam KH0.2 build 15194283; English kh02_map.locres joined to TresMapNameTable/TresAreaNameTable. Extracted static rows are identical to all live table rows.
join: Exact nameKey and areaKey/subareaKey lookup into English namespace.key. World / map / subarea names are joined once, removing duplicates.
unknown_policy: Unknown label returns empty; GetLocation retains raw current map ID. Unknown Discord world asset uses logo. The known dw asset is darkworld as specified by the user.
stale_area_policy: Area accepted only when its exact catalog canonical map equals raw current World name, or its catalog key starts with raw current map + _An_. Alias normalization is only used for display lookup.

difficulty.proof: Native switch at RVA 0x5539E6 selects GameStaticAsset coordinator class fields +0x148/+0x150/+0x158/+0x160; installed reflected field names encode this exact difficulty order.
